testCases.input: What is the message of Lesson 6, 'Work to Learn—Don't Work for Money'?
testCases.expectedOutput: The author encourages people to work to develop useful skills rather than choosing work only for a paycheck. He emphasizes learning skills that can transfer across situations, including communication, sales, marketing, and understanding business systems.
